The contract describes a synchronous, non-bypassing, lossless ready/valid queue with capacity 2**ADDR_WIDTH words. It has DATA_WIDTH payload bits, LAST and USER sidebands.

Key points from contract:
- Active-high synchronous reset flushes all accepted but unconsumed words at each rising edge. While reset is asserted, s_ready and m_valid are zero. The first four directed cycles assert reset.
- Transfer occurs on rising edge when valid and ready both high. Source must hold valid and data/sidebands while stalled, unless reset asserted. Receiver may stop for any number of cycles.
- m_valid high exactly when buffered words exist. Head data and sidebands stable while stalled. No direct input-to-output bypass.
- s_ready must be high exactly when reset is low and either there is unused capacity or an existing head word will be consumed on this edge. Full-capacity simultaneous dequeue/enqueue must be supported.
- Each accepted word appears once and in order unless flushed by reset. New traffic must work after reset.

Parameters: Directed checks use DATA_WIDTH=8 and ADDR_WIDTH in {1,2,3}. Formal checks use listed fixed profiles only.

    output wire m_valid,
    input wire m_ready,
    output wire m_last,
    output wire m_user

localparam DEPTH = 1 << ADDR_WIDTH;
reg [DATA_WIDTH+1:0] mem [0:DEPTH-1];
reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_ptr = 0;
reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_ptr = 0;
reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0] count = 0;

assign s_ready = !rst && ((count <= DEPTH) || (m_ready && m_valid));
assign {m_last, m_user, m_data} = mem[rd_ptr];

wire pop = m_valid && m_ready;

    if (rst) begin
        wr_ptr <= 0;
        rd_ptr <= 0;
        count <= 0;

        if (push) begin
            mem[wr_ptr] <= {s_last, s_user, s_data};

        if (pop) rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1'b1;
        case ({push, pop})
            2'b10: count <= count + 1'b1;
            2'b01: count <= count - 1'b1;

endmodule
